tools.name: compare_portals
tools.description: Compare cashback and rewards rates across all portals for a specific merchant, in the US or UK. Returns the best deals and effective value.

tools.name: best_portal
tools.description: Find the best portal for a merchant by effective value: a recommendation plus the next two alternatives, each with a go_url, and a shop-direct link.

tools.name: search_merchants
tools.description: Search for merchants that have live rates, by name or domain.

tools.name: find_by_url
tools.description: Find rates for a merchant by their website URL.

tools.name: get_portal
tools.description: Get information about a specific shopping portal.

tools.name: list_portal_bonuses
tools.description: List current bonus offers and promotions from shopping portals.

tools.name: get_deals
tools.description: Current verified sales and promo codes for a merchant. Returns an empty list when we have none on file; we never guess codes.

tools.name: best_deal
tools.description: Stack the best verified sale, promo code and portal reward for a basket at a merchant, and show the final cost.

tools.name: deals_now
tools.description: Top verified sales right now across all merchants, optionally by category.

tools.name: black_friday
tools.description: Best current cashback and airline shopping-portal rates at popular Black Friday and Cyber Monday stores in the US and UK. Returns live rates only; stores with no rate are omitted. Optional country filters to one list. Same data as https://whichportal.com/black-friday.json.

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description: Send feedback when a result looked wrong, a store or portal is missing, a link is broken, or you have a bug report or suggestion. Use this after a compare or search result seems incorrect, or when a merchant or portal is not in the catalog. Do not include passwords, API keys or other secrets.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "submit_feedback" references sensitive artifacts (password, secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
